name: face click

name: edge click

history.note: Only the 6 faces are hit-tested (viewcube() builds one quad per face). Clicking the band along an edge picks the nearest face. Fusion has 12 edge hot spots that go to the 45-degree view between two faces. StandardView has no edge or corner views.
Verified on parity2 (b2bb8fe, #107): the TOP/RIGHT edge goes to the 45-degree view between them.

notes: Verified on parity2 (b2bb8fe, #107): the TOP/RIGHT edge goes to the 45-degree view between them.

name: corner click

history.note: Clicking the front-top-right corner went to TOP. Fusion has 8 corner hot spots, one isometric view each. Needs edge/corner hit zones (inset each face quad, so the outer band is edges and the corners are corners) plus arbitrary-direction views in Camera.
Verified on parity2 (b2bb8fe, #107): corner hot spots go to their isometric views.

notes: Verified on parity2 (b2bb8fe, #107): corner hot spots go to their isometric views.

name: no phantom saves
fusion: Fusion only adds a Data panel entry when the user saves; unsaved untitled designs never appear there.

history.note: The hub has 117 items, almost all empty 'Untitled' designs (0 features, origin 'saved', 193-byte .fox). Overnight they appeared at 02:53, 02:56, 02:57, 03:01 (x4), 03:06, 03:07, 03:08 and 03:09, each logged as 'created Untitled'. Not caused by idling (90 s, none), a click on the canvas, launching a second instance, or fissionoxide-cli info/render. Some UI path is calling hub.save (data_panel.rs:933) on an empty untitled design; it lines up with the window being activated or a file being forwarded. Fix the trigger, and don't hub.save an empty, unnamed design without the user asking.

Root cause found 2026-10-20 09:05: the junk comes from cargo test runs, not the UI. Tests that save via the UI path fall back to Store::default_root() (the real %APPDATA% hub) unless FOX_DATA_DIR is set; the hub grew 116 -> 241 while agents ran tests. PR #100 guards the UI side; parity/ui-test-hub-isolation isolates tests.

Root cause: fox-engine test tests::every_listed_command_is_handled runs every command (including hub.save) on a Session with no store_root, so each test run wrote empty 'Untitled' designs into the real %APPDATA% hub (38 hub touches per run). PR #116 makes test processes never resolve to the real hub; PR #100 (merged) guards the UI side.

notes: Root cause: fox-engine test tests::every_listed_command_is_handled runs every command (including hub.save) on a Session with no store_root, so each test run wrote empty 'Untitled' designs into the real %APPDATA% hub (38 hub touches per run). name: horizontal conflict
fusion: Selecting a line and clicking Horizontal/Vertical always applies the constraint when the sketch has enough freedom: Fusion rotates the line about its fixed or coincident end, moving the free end.

history.note: On a line that was trimmed against a circle (one end coincident with the circle, the other free, 6 degrees of freedom in the sketch) Horizontal/Vertical shows "that constraint conflicts with the others (or over-constrains the sketch)" and nothing changes. On a free line it works.

Sketch::solve now turns a line a new Horizontal/Vertical has yet to straighten about the end something holds (fixed, named by another constraint, or shared with another curve) when the other end is free, keeping its length, before the Gauss-Newton pass: a line trimmed onto a circle swings about the end on the circle and the circle stays, as Fusion does, instead of the minimum-norm step dragging the circle and both ends (and collapsing a vertical line made horizontal to a point). Tests: solver (crates/sketch/src/solve.rs), command path on a face sketch with the prober's circle, diameter edit, trim and offset (crates/engine/src/tests.rs), and the palette's Horizontal/Vertical (crates/ui/src/lib.rs). The refusal itself could not be reproduced from the command path: every variant solved; re-probe in the app. Commit 77913d4.

notes: On a line that was trimmed against a circle (one end coincident with the circle, the other free, 6 degrees of freedom in the sketch) Horizontal/Vertical shows "that constraint conflicts with the others (or over-constrains the sketch)" and nothing changes. On a free line it works.

name: ribbon tooltip texts
fusion: SOLID tab, in order. Create Sketch: "Enters Sketch mode, where you create geometric profiles that define the foundation of a design. Then use commands like Extrude, Revolve, and Loft to create 3D bodies from sketches." / "Select a construction plane, then create lines, arcs, or points to create sketch and construction geometry. Constrain sketches with dimensions and constraints. Select Finish Sketch to exit Sketch mode." Extrude (E): "Adds depth to open or closed sketch profiles or faces." / "Select an extrusion type, select sketch profiles or faces to extrude, then specify the distance and taper angle. For the Thin Extrude type, specify the wall thickness." Revolve: "Revolves a sketch profile or planar face around a selected axis." / "Select a profile or planar face and an axis to revolve around, then specify the extent type, direction, and operation." Hole (H): "Creates a hole based on user-specified values and selections." / "Select a face to place the hole then select edges to position the hole on the face, or select sketch points to place multiple holes. Specify the hole type, tap type and size values." Rectangular Pattern: "Duplicates faces, bodies, features, or components in a design and distributes them along linear axes in rows and columns to create a rectangular pattern." / "Select the object type, then select objects to pattern in the canvas, Browser, or Timeline. Select one or more axes to distribute the pattern instances along, then adjust Suppression, quantity, and distance. Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern." Press Pull (Q): "Modifies the selected geometry using offset, extrude, or fillet commands. The operation depends on the geometry selected." Fillet (F): "Rounds the edges of a solid body by adding material to interior edges and removing material from exterior edges." / "Select edges, faces, or features, then specify a radius. Use the Rule Fillet type to add fillets based on specified rules. Use the Full Round Fillet type to round the edges over three adjacent faces." Shell: "Offsets the walls of a solid body to create a hollow cavity with walls of a specified thickness." / "Select a body to shell or faces to remove to create an opening, then specify a type, direction, and wall thickness." Combine: "Joins, cuts, or intersects two or more solid bodies to create a single solid body." / "Select the target body, select one or more tool bodies to combine with the target body, then select the operation to use to combine the bodies together." Configure: "Opens the Configuration Table, enters Configuration Mode, and highlights configurable features and objects in the Timeline and Browser." / "Add Configurations as rows in the table to create different variants of a design. Click highlighted features and objects to add their configurable aspects as columns in the table." Display Configuration Table: "Shows or hides the Configure dialog without entering Configuration Mode." Create Configuration Rules: "Creates logical Configuration Rules that drive or limit configured aspect values in a Configured Design, to ensure only valid configurations can be created." / "Drag and drop blocks into the Configuration Rules canvas to create logical rules, then apply them to the set of configurations." Offset Plane: "Creates a Construction Plane that is offset from the selected face or plane." / "Select a face, plane or sketch profile, then specify the offset distance." Measure (I): "Measures the distance, angle, area, or position of selected objects." / "Select an object to measure it, and optionally select a second object to measure it and the distance between them." Section Analysis: "Creates a view that cuts through all visible objects in a design to reveal interior details and obscured features." / "Select a planar object to define the cut plane, then adjust the distance and angles to position it in the design. In the Browser, the Section Analysis displays in the Analysis folder, where you can adjust its visibility, edit it, or delete it." Insert Derive: "Pulls and links design features from another design into the active design. When you update the derived features in the original design, the changes are reflected in the destination design." / "Before you start, activate the component that you want to contain the derived design features. Select a design, then select a set of components, bodies, sketches, construction geometry, flat patterns, or parameters to derive into the current design." Canvas: "Places an image on a planar face or sketch plane." / "Select a face then select an image to import." Insert Mesh: "Inserts an existing STL, OBJ, or 3MF file as a mesh body into the active component in a design." / "Select a file to insert. The contents of the file display as a mesh body in the canvas and the browser." / "For STL or OBJ files, select the unit type that matches the units from the original design that generated the STL or OBJ." Add To Assembly: "Inserts the active design into an Assembly Design as an external component." / "Select an Assembly Design to insert into, then use the manipulators in the canvas or Initial Position fields to place the component in the target design." Select: "Selection is ... mode displ..." (clipped by the window edge; re-read it with a wider window).

history.note: Its own one-line descriptions and usage lines for every button (Create Sketch "Starts a new sketch on a plane or planar face.", Extrude "Adds depth to a closed sketch profile or a planar face.", Revolve "Spins a sketch profile around an axis.", Hole "Drills holes, with counterbores, countersinks or threads.", Rectangular Pattern "Copies bodies, faces or features in rows and columns.", Create Form "Starts a freeform modelling space for sculpted T-spline shapes.", Press Pull "Pushes or pulls faces along their normals.", Fillet "Rounds the selected edges.", Shell "Hollows a body to a wall thickness, removing the faces you pick.", Combine "Joins, cuts or intersects bodies.", Split Body, Move/Copy, Bill of Materials, Configure "Sets up variants of the design, such as sizes, in one table.", Display Configuration Table "Shows the table of the design's configurations.", Create Configuration Rules (+ "Not in FissionOxide yet"), Offset Plane "Creates a plane parallel to a plane or face at a distance.", Measure "Measures distances, angles, areas and lengths of the selection.", Section Analysis "Cuts the view open along a plane to show the inside.", Insert Derive (+ "Not in FissionOxide yet"), Canvas "Places a reference image on a plane to sketch over.", Insert Mesh "Inserts an STL, OBJ or 3MF file as a mesh body.", Add To Assembly (+ "Not in FissionOxide yet"), Select "Selects faces, edges, bodies and profiles by clicking.").
